assumptions.capacitor_technology_required: C0G or equivalent bounded effective capacitance; no part selected
assumptions.external_release_resolution: Metastability and actual synchronizer choice remain open; no bounded analog resolution assumed

negative.case: Unstretched raw reset shorter than RC assertion
negative.reason: Such a pulse cannot guarantee bank reset; input pulse stretcher is required, not silently filtered as a completed reset
